name: refnx contrast reflectometry inversion
description: infer_profile(training_contrasts, bounds, metadata) -> 32..4096 posterior rows [oxide thickness A, film thickness A, dry film SLD 1e-6/A^2, solvent fraction, roughness A, background]. Independent Parratt recursion with Nevot-Croce roughness and Gaussian Q-resolution predicts the wholly held-out contrast. Score posterior predictive normalized residual plus simulation-track CRPS. Source experimental contrasts are one physical sample, no cross-sample generalization claim.

papers.title: Fast and Reliable Probabilistic Reflectometry Inversion with Prior-Amortized Neural Posterior Estimation
papers.task_relation: The local refnx task infers six layered-sample parameters and predicts a held-out contrast using three curves from one physical sample plus simulated training tracks. These contrast and parameter choices are a restricted local inverse problem, not the source paper's complete datasets or method.
papers.primary_goal: Recover probabilistic thin-film structural information from ambiguous X-ray and neutron reflectometry data.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Infer uncertain thin-film structure and composition from reflectometry measurements.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Resolving ambiguous structural inversions with calibrated posterior information is the paper's principal physical inference problem.
science_relevance.reason: The evidence directly targets reflectometry inversion; a reflectometry software paper alone would not establish the label.
